headline: Tenda shares lead Ibovespa declines amid margin concerns
summary: Shares of Brazilian homebuilder Tenda fell sharply on the Ibovespa following third-quarter results. Analysts cited deteriorating margins, restricted mortgage credit, and rising default risks as primary concerns for the company.
why: Tenda is a major player in the Brazilian low-income housing sector, which is highly sensitive to interest rates and government housing policy.

impacts.name: Tenda
impacts.why: Poor earnings results and margin pressure directly impact investor sentiment.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Investors reacted to negative earnings reports highlighting margin compression and credit risks in the housing sector.
